in_marathi.name: Sarangi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lady of the forest
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarangi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Sarangi is the name of a beautiful woman who lives in the forest. She is the embodiment of nature and is often depicted as playing the Sarangi, a stringed musical instrument, to soothe the troubled souls.
